\subsection{Second confirmatory family: gpt-oss-20b (amendment v1.5)}\label{sec:llama}
Amendment v1.5 replaced the deferred Llama-3.1-8B with gpt-oss-20b as the second confirmatory family, before any call to either model (reasoning effort low; only the final message is parsed, never the reasoning). It ran at the largest preregistered cut that fit the available window (cut 5: arms \arm{J}, \arm{JL}, \arm{M}, \arm{MS}; threats \thr{T0}, \thr{T2a}, \thr{T3}; 36 tasks; 432 scored roots). The Qwen3 single-family results above remain the primary analysis. Table~\ref{tab:llama} reports the same contrasts for gpt-oss-20b (its own Holm family) and for the pooled analysis of the cells both families share, which restores the original v1 primary analysis (clusters: family $\times$ task).
In gpt-oss-20b, H1 is \ResFtHOneVerdict{} (\ResFtHOneDiff{}, \ResFtHOneCI{}), H2 is \ResFtHTwoVerdict{} (\ResFtHTwoDiff{}), H3a is \ResFtHThreeaVerdict{} (\ResFtHThreeaDiff{}), and for H3b the two manifests are \ResFtHThreebVerdict{}. In the pooled analysis, H1 is \ResPoolHOneVerdict{} (\ResPoolHOneDiff{}, \ResPoolHOneCI{}), H2 is \ResPoolHTwoVerdict{}, H3a is \ResPoolHThreeaVerdict{}, and for H3b the two manifests are \ResPoolHThreebVerdict{}.
